zh: 多用户与智能体技能（Agent Skills）深度隔离与资产管理升级：全面支持标准技能包完整导入与二进制/脚本生命周期打包，新增用户级浏览器书签与独立工作区持久化隔离，支持跨端多会话无缝续跑与凭据安全脱敏。
TestFlight 外部测试全自动审核队列置换：自动化检测苹果后台待审槽位，当检测到审核限制时自动将排队中的旧版本设为过期释放名额，确保最新版本永远全自动顶进审核第一顺位，彻底杜绝中间版本堆积。
iOS 移动端交互体验与视觉响应重构：修复侧边栏「开启新对话」触控热区穿透问题并支持全卡片高灵敏点击与轻点震动，消除明暗主题切换延迟并实现全局 220ms 平滑渐变，全面遵循 Apple HIG 44pt 最小点击规范。
en: Multi-user and Agent Skills isolation and asset management overhaul: full support for importing standard skill packages with associated scripts and binary assets, dedicated per-user browser bookmark repository, and isolated workspace state with credentials redaction.

Automated TestFlight Beta App Review queue displacement: intelligently detects Apple submission limit and automatically expires stale waiting builds to release review slots, ensuring newest builds always enter the review queue automatically without manual intervention.

iOS mobile UX and theme responsiveness redesign: resolved asymmetric touch-target penetration on 'New Chat' button with 100% card responsiveness and haptic feedback, synchronized instant 220ms theme transitions across all inputs, and enforced Apple HIG 44pt minimum touch-target compliance.
